about: The evangelium of the formulary “Second Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time Jesus said to the Pharisees: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd giveth his life for his sheep. But the hireling, who is not the shepherd and whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming and leaveth the sheep and fleeth; and the wolf catcheth and scattereth the sheep. The hireling fleeth because he is a hireling and hath no care for the sheep. I am the good shepherd; I know Mine, and Mine know Me. As the Father knoweth Me, and I know the Father, and I lay down My life for My sheep. And other sheep I have that are not of this fold; them also I must bring, and they shall hear My voice, and there shall be one fold and one shepherd.
